_noteP: Pit Grit -- Heavy Hands: every other basic attack (the empowered 'Right Punch') deals bonus physical damage. SettPassive.RightPunchBonus = ByCharLevelFormula(0->150 by champion level) + StatByCoefficient(mStat=2 AD, mStatFormula=2 = BONUS AD, coefficient 0.55) = wiki's '5-90 (based on level) (+55% bonus AD)'. Modeled as a P bonusEffect trigger onHit (approximates the alternating-punch proc as firing on every attack, same style as Riven P/Leona P precedent). Heart of the Half-Beast (the other Pit Grit component, HealingCalc) is pure health regen scaling off missing health -- not damage, omitted.
_noteQ: Knuckle Down: empowers the next TWO basic attacks (5s window) to each deal bonus physical damage = flat BaseDamage (10/20/30/40/50, DataValues rank-indexed) + a %-of-target's-max-health term. That %maxHP term is its OWN GameCalculation ('MaxHealthDamageCalc', mDisplayAsPercent=true) = NamedDataValue(EnemyMaxHealthDamage=0.01 flat 1%) + StatByNamedDataValue(mStat=2 TOTAL AD, mDataValue=MaxHealthTADRatio, a tiny per-rank per-1-AD coefficient) -- confirmed against wiki's '(+1% (+1/1.5/2/2.5/3% per 100 AD) of target's maximum health)' (MaxHealthTADRatioTOOLTIP DataValue = 0.5/1.0/1.5/2.0/2.5/3.0/3.5, i.e. exactly half the wiki's 'per 100 AD' figures because DataValues are per-rank arrays with an unused index 0). Curated as TWO independent hits (flatDataValue BaseDamage + hpPercentCalc MaxHealthDamageCalc, hpBasis Max) at count 2 each, matching the wiki's explicit 'Total Bonus Physical Damage: 20/40/60/80/100 (+2% (+2/3/4/5/6% per 100 AD))' line for landing both empowered punches on one target. QMinimumDamage (a per-monster floor) and MonsterCap (400, a vs-monster cap) are not modeled -- combo target is a champion. _noteW: Haymaker: DamageCalc = NamedDataValue(BaseDamage) ONLY = 80/100/120/140/160, matching the wiki's flat base exactly. The wiki's extra '(+25% (+25% per 100 bonus AD) of expended Grit)' term is NOT resolvable: the BIN's own 'DamageConversion'/'MaxDamage' calcs multiply that %-of-AD conversion against 'MaxGrit' = StatByNamedDataValue(mStat=12 [this codebase's Health stat id] x DataValue StoredHealth), which computes Sett's THEORETICAL max Grit CAP (a fraction of his own max health, per the wiki's 'up to 50% of maximum health' cap) -- not the actual LIVE Grit accumulated at cast time, which depends on recent damage taken and is not tracked by ActivePlayerStats. Using the cap value would systematically overstate real damage (P2: no fabricated best-case inference), so the Grit-scaling bonus is honestly omitted; only the flat base is curated. Center-line hits are True damage instead of Physical (same DamageCalc number, different type) -- the more common cone-edge case (Physical) is kept as the single modeled hit, consistent with this project's one-hit-per-slot convention when a mechanic branches by hit location.
_noteE: Facebreaker: DamageCalc = NamedDataValue(BaseDamage) [50/70/90/110/130] + StatByCoefficient(mStat=2 TOTAL AD, no mStatFormula, coefficient 0.6) = wiki's '50/70/90/110/130 (+60% AD)' (total AD, matches -- no 'bonus' qualifier in either source). MonsterBonus (a separate vs-monster-only interpolated bonus) is not modeled -- combo target is a champion. [M32 pilot-crosscheck follow-up ADJUDICATED 2026-07-24: SingleBaseDamage [10..60] and MaxHealthDamage [0.10 const] are referenced by ZERO SettE calcs and absent from the live tooltip - rework leftovers, correctly NOT curated (DamageCalc = BaseDamage + 0.6 AD is the whole live ability).]
_noteR: The Show Stopper: DamageCalc = NamedDataValue(BaseDamage) [200/300/400] + StatByCoefficient(mStat=2 AD, mStatFormula=2 = BONUS AD, coefficient 1.2) = wiki's '200/300/400 (+120% bonus AD)' -- the champion-center-hit line, matching exactly. The wiki's additional '(+40/50/60% of primary target's BONUS health)' term (BIN calc 'MaxHealthDamageCalc' = NamedDataValue(MaxHealthDamage) alone, DataValues 0.4/0.5/0.6) scales off the TARGET's bonus health (max HP minus base HP), which this schema's HpBasis enum cannot express (only target Max/Current/Missing HP as a whole, not the bonus-HP sub-component) -- genuinely blocked, no fabricated approximation, honest omission per P2. The 'Reduced Damage' edge-of-shockwave variant (also lower AD/bonus-health ratios) is likewise not modeled -- the full center-hit value is kept as the single conservative representative hit.
